comment: 1 of 20 cases skipped. It is new in 16.4, and its deploy branch asserts Vercel's
minimal-mode serving: a repeat navigation to an on-demand param of a fully static page
makes no request, because the platform answers the RSC navigation with a completed
prerender ('#'-marked). cdk-nextjs runs Next.js like `next start`, which answers it with
a live render (unmarked, so partial) - the case's own non-deploy branch expects exactly
that request. Unsupported (next start serving model); see docs/harness-coverage.md.

comment: 2 of its cases (one per `parallelRouteMetadata` describe) skipped.
New in 16.4 and `// @gate !deploy`: in deploy mode next.js runs it as `.failing`, because Vercel's deploy harness does not expose the emitted server bundle; ours builds in the test dir, so it does.
cdk-nextjs passes it, so jest reports "Failing test passed even though it was supposed to fail"
on both attempts, on every NextjsType (2026-10-08 run). Skipped as a gate inversion, not a
defect; see docs/harness-coverage.md.
